issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning String, but the intended/implemented API in the solution returns an int. The template contains a TODO for this method and the textual hint explicitly tells students to check the UML for the expected return type, which will lead students to implement a String return type and thus conflict with the solution/tests expecting an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Preferably update the UML and problem statement to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (since it returns a numeric total), or else change the solution/template implementation to return a String if the exercise intentionally expects a formatted string. Also update the hint text to reference the corrected UML/type.
